# Security

The maintained release is `v1.0.0`.

Send suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/EnesKeremAYDIN/SeniorMode/security/advisories/new) when the repository enables it. If that surface is unavailable, open a public issue describing the affected area at a high level and request a private channel. Keep sensitive evidence out of public issues.

Include the affected version, impact, operating system, and minimal evidence needed to inspect the behavior. See [Security in the README](../README.md#security) for how SeniorMode works locally.
